title: Hamiltonian Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The Hamiltonian for a charged particle in an electromagnetic field must be correctly stated.

title: Schrödinger Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The steady-state Schrödinger equation for the hydrogen atom in a magnetic field must be accurately derived.

title: Energy Shift Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The perturbation approach to calculate the ground state energy shift due to the magnetic field must be correctly applied.

title: Diamagnetic Moment
description: Essential Criteria: The induced diamagnetic moment per atom must be correctly expressed in terms of the derived energy shift.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistently applied throughout the calculations to ensure physical correctness.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the Hamiltonian or energy shift calculations must be avoided.
